test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question: Radius of a large solid sphere is 14 cm. If is melted to form 8 equal small solid sphere. What is the sum of total surface areas of all the 8 small solid spheres ? (use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If a large sphere of radius R is melted into n equal small spheres of radius r, then r = R ÷ n¹/³.

Here n = 8, so r = 14 ÷ 8¹/³ = 14 ÷ 2 = 7 cm.

Sum of Surface Areas of n small spheres = n × 4πr².

Sum = 8 × 4 × (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 32 × 154 = 4928 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 4928 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of large sphere (R) = 14 cm

Number of small spheres (n) = 8

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr³

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Sphere = 4πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5afcec6d494d960a3497853ef70da045b4f5132af3feafc5eb647079b1a567a8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of large sphere = 8 × Volume of one small sphere

⇒ (4/3) × π × (14)³ = 8 × (4/3) × π × r³

⇒ 14 × 14 × 14 = 8 × r³

⇒ r³ = (14 × 14 × 14) ÷ 8

⇒ r³ = 2744 ÷ 8 = 343

⇒ r = √³(343) = 7 cm

⇒ TSA of one small sphere = 4 × (22/7) × 7 × 7

⇒ TSA of one small sphere = 4 × 22 × 7 = 616 cm²

⇒ Sum of TSA of all 8 small spheres = 8 × 616

⇒ Sum of TSA = 4928 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4928 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume and Surface Area Scaling

If the radius of a sphere is scaled by a factor k, the volume scales by k³ and the surface area scales by k².

Hemisphere Formulas

For a solid hemisphere of radius r, Volume = (2/3)πr³, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Mass and Density Relation

When an object is melted and recast, its volume remains constant (provided there is no material loss), such that Vᵢₙᵢₜᵢₐₗ = Vfᵢₙₐₗ.</p
